title: Homemade Cranberry Sauce
tagline: Fresh cranberries and sugar, ten minutes at a boil, then chilled overnight — better if you make it a day ahead.

steps.text: Rinse cranberries in a colander and discard any bruised or spoiled berries.
In a medium saucepan, bring 1 cup of water to a boil. Add the sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add the cranberries and boil for about 10 minutes. Take off heat and let sit covered for about 30 minutes.
Transfer into a serving bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. The sauce tastes great if made one day ahead!
